executive_summary: Jordan, age 38, has a solid foundation: positive cash flow, retirement contributions in place, and term life insurance. The biggest leverage points are accelerating credit card payoff (saving ~$4,800 in interest) and raising the 401(k) deferral from 8% to 12% to close the retirement gap by age 65. Estate documents are missing — a critical fix.

category_notes.cash_flow: 21% savings rate is above average. Housing at 28% of income is healthy.
category_notes.debt: Credit card balance at 22% APR is dragging the score. Avalanche payoff in 14 months.
category_notes.investments: Equity-heavy allocation suits age 38. Slight overweight in US large-cap.
category_notes.retirement: On track for ~85% of target at age 65. Boosting contributions closes the gap.
category_notes.protection: Term life is good. Disability coverage is partial. No will or POA on file.

cash_flow.commentary: Dining + subscriptions ($515/mo) is the easiest place to recapture $150–$200/month and redirect it to debt payoff or retirement contributions.

investments.commentary: US large-cap is overweight by 8 percentage points. Rebalance toward international and bonds to reduce single-country concentration risk.

retirement.commentary: Bumping the 401(k) deferral from 8% to 12% closes the gap and captures additional employer match if the plan allows. Run /finance-retirement to model spousal contributions.

items.name: Term Life Insurance
items.recommendation: $1M policy in place — review every 3 years.

items.name: Disability Insurance
items.recommendation: Employer LTD covers 60%. Consider supplemental own-occupation policy.

items.name: Health Insurance
items.recommendation: HDHP + HSA — max HSA contributions for triple tax benefit.

items.name: Auto / Home
items.recommendation: Umbrella liability of $1M is recommended given net worth.

items.name: Will / Estate Plan
items.recommendation: CRITICAL — draft will, POA, and healthcare directive this quarter.

items.name: Emergency Fund
items.recommendation: $11k of $24k target (4 months expenses). Build to 6 months.

protection.commentary: Missing estate documents are the single highest-impact protection gap. An online platform (e.g., trust & will services) can deliver a basic will + POA in under 60 minutes.

action_items.action: Draft will, POA, and healthcare directive
Throw $400/mo extra at Chase credit card (22% APR)
Rebalance portfolio: trim US large-cap, add international
Open Roth IRA for spouse (backdoor if needed)

month_1: Open online will service account and complete will + POA
Set up auto-transfer of $400/mo to credit card payoff
Open HSA if not already open
month_2: Increase 401(k) deferral to 12% via HR portal
ninety_day_plan.after_90_days: Re-run /finance to see updated Financial Health Score. Most clients executing this plan move from B- to B+ or A- in 90 days.
